actualCourseGround: The complete primary page32 prints this operator as common gA/eA text; separately bold radical mechanism and Nano duties are eA only.
component: Molecular structure explains polymer property profiles: chain packing, intermolecular interactions and network topology.
scientificReason: The complete common-course Sachkompetenz expressly requires explaining the properties of all three plastic types through molecular structure. The whole2652 description directly explains how monomers and macromolecular linkages lead to diverse property profiles. This is a legitimate explanatory structural component. PE branching/packing, PA intermolecular contacts and a supplied polymer network are curriculum-curated concrete materials, rather than a new mandatory industrial product or a choice of a separate optional topic.
exactBoundary: 2652 alone is not a complete three-type source witness: its two present cases do not independently establish the whole thermoplast/thermoset/elastomer classification-and-property duty. Keep the original3e9 and3aef partners and the full source002 operator. The new edge stays PARTIAL; no full original union approval is produced.

actualCourseGround: The complete primary page32 prints this operator as common gA/eA text; separately bold radical mechanism and Nano duties are eA only.
component: Explain selected plastic functionality through structural and property relations, then connect those relations to a technical use.
scientificReason: The common-course Kommunikationskompetenz explicitly requires using subject knowledge to explain functionality of selected plastics. The entire2652 goal connects monomers/linkages, property profiles and special technical uses. The supplied PE-film/PA-fibre choices and polymer-network/regranulate context are faithful curated realizations of that selected-material explanatory competence. A teacher-specific prior selection is not required to author such a curriculum example; no actual classroom choice is asserted. The reference is direct functionality, not societal evaluation or requires closure.
exactBoundary: A narrow functionality clause is not proof of every possible use or all other operators in2652. Keep the original3e9 partner and all source006 text. Selected PA property/function examples do not turn a general polycondensation-synthesis curriculum into a required NI GK/LK family.

component: Monomers are linked into a polymer chain in a selected polymerisation example.
scientificReason: The common-course Sachkompetenz requires describing the reaction type of polymerisation. The actual page immediately distinguishes the bold eA radical-mechanism duty. Explaining macromolecular formation in the whole2652 description can therefore carry a bounded polymerisation component, exemplified by PE from ethene. The source supports the reaction-type relationship and the formation component; it does not require an industrial installation, a real experiment or the eA chain-mechanism stages at gA.
exactBoundary: This source010 does not itself supply the whole property/functionality goal or a general NI polycondensation entitlement. The separate source002/006 operators supply the property/function links; existing6eb remains unchanged as an original partner. Its preservation is not a new full GK approval of6eb’s radical-mechanism body. The new PARTIAL edge does not independently approve this reviewer’s own new PE task, model answer, rubric or P evidence.
